div.div:
📌 rsi_regime Calculation:
• Overbought: rsi ≥ 70
• Bullish: 55 < rsi < 70
• Neutral: 45 ≤ rsi ≤ 55
• Bearish: 30 < rsi < 45
• Oversold: rsi ≤ 30

div.div:
📌 imbalance_regime Calculation:
• Heavy Buying: imbalance > +0.50
• Moderate Buying: +0.15 to +0.50
• Neutral: -0.15 to +0.15
• Moderate Selling: -0.50 to -0.15
• Heavy Selling: imbalance < -0.50

div.div:
📌 volatility_regime Calculation:
• Extreme: vol > 0.015 (>95th pct)
• High: vol > 0.008 (>75th pct)
• Moderate: vol > 0.003 (>25th pct)
• Low / Squeeze: vol ≤ 0.003
